mandatory_tactical_invariants.rule: Only catalog operators with identity.rarity 1-3 and qualification.normal_mode=true are legal; exclude mode-specific reserves. Read-only catalog count confirmed 17 ordinary three-star operators.
DEPLOY uses integer [row,col] and UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT. Forbidden tiles are [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Never exceed eight deployed operators. Every deployment requires actual DP, a legal vacant tile, a slot and completed actual cooldown.
The no-refund economic chain requires Fang alive through its fifth actual income and all four declared Vanilla activations. Missing income is a survival failure, not a ledger repair opportunity.
Every blocker handoff requires the predecessor alive, an affordable replacement and safe reacquisition. An unmet gate rejects the fixed candidate.
Credit no refunds, unsupported talents, Cardigan self-healing, probabilistic effects, guaranteed splash, civilian healing or invented target ordering.
Manual skills require actual readiness; inactive time-SP recovery is 1 SP/s and pauses during active skills. Conditional continuation skills require combat still active.
Patrol death must be observed before frame 3759. Neither caster may withdraw under an unmet patrol-death gate.
Civilian protection requires observed zero deaths. Officers may attack civilians within 1.2 even before reaching a blocker.
Clearance requires exhausted hostile spawns and zero living hostiles. Retreat Hibiscus and Ansel before deploying onto their tiles.
An already absent Lancet-2 retreat is optional. Other failed fixed actions invalidate the candidate; deterministic checks may reject actions but may not choose substitutions.
WIN requires remaining_life>0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies. Acceptance also requires two civilian arrivals, zero civilian deaths and completion within 600 seconds.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Use four early interceptions, dedicated lower opening healing and Kroos-assisted upper clearance. Establish both medics before patrol casters, replace fragile outer blockers earlier, then convert the central economic holds into sustained damage. Release civilians through four explicit roadblock assignments after hostile clearance. This is an unverified full-stage candidate.

unknown_dependencies.dependency: Shared upper healing must preserve Castle-3 until Kroos clears its runner, and both pioneers must survive to their required income endpoints.

One medic may fail to restore a caster between patrol strikes. Boost timing, caster HP and actual attack acquisition must satisfy the patrol-survival and death gates; geometry alone does not establish them.
The first upper armor engagement and lower armor pressure between Midnight skills require sufficient actual healing and damage.
Officer attacks near upstream roadblocks, device destruction durations and civilian arrival times remain unverified.

verification.limitation: Affordability assumes the specified survival and actual income. No battle success or client timing is established.
verification.method: Read-only source inspection, declared range checks and conditional no-refund DP arithmetic; no stage simulation.
verification.range_result: Declared opening healing, Kroos support, patrol coverage and Durin upper support checked with the current range transformer.

revised_stage_understanding.CURRENT_MODEL: Civilians are neutral and excluded from ordinary attacks and blocking. Safe arrival costs no life; death costs one. Officers can attack civilians within 1.2. Ordinary-targetable roadblocks require actual destruction.
revised_stage_understanding.GameData: Four hostile ground approaches, one flying patrol, two civilians and four active roadblocks; source wave offsets and operator configurations govern this candidate.
revised_stage_understanding.UNKNOWN: Client timing and target priority, active-device ordinary WALK navigation, unsupported effects, caster survival and full-stage throughput.
revised_stage_understanding.feedback_status: V5 provides verified causal combat failures. V7 failed its hypothesis-reference contract and provides no simulated performance.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.acceptance: Reject any failed survival, income, readiness, handoff, patrol-death, civilian-protection or completion gate. Static feasibility is not WIN.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.thesis: Damaging upper support and dedicated lower healing preserve the opening economic chain; earlier defender replacements stabilize outer lanes; concentrated patrol fire precedes central Arts support and explicit civilian clearance.

revised_tactical_requirements.failure_policy: Reject unmet fixed-action gates; do not repair tactics through automatic substitutions or inferred refunds.
